recognize_zh: 周邊血液中間一個大型單核球，核呈腎形／摺疊、染色質花邊狀、胞質灰藍豐富，旁邊兩個中性球；兒童血片中單核球增多是 JMML 的核心診斷條件（絕對單核球數 ≥1×10⁹/L）。
features: Large monocyte with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and a folded, kidney-shaped nucleus with lacy chromatin
Two segmented neutrophils with normal granulation
Red cells with mild anisocytosis, occasional target cells and an elongated echinocyte
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature-appearing monocyte with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and a folded, reniform nucleus with lacy chromatin, accompanied by two segmented neutrophils. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional target cells and an echinocyte, and platelets are present in small numbers. No blasts are seen in this field. A single monocyte is nonspecific, but an absolute monocytosis in a young child is a required criterion for juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia and should prompt a full differential count and molecular evaluation.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytosis accompanies infection or inflammation without immature myeloid cells, nucleated red cells, thrombocytopenia or clonal mutations.
CMML shows similar mature monocytosis but occurs in adults.
Promonocytes have more delicate chromatin, visible nucleoli and more basophilic cytoplasm than this mature monocyte.
